description: This file contains C source code for GStreamer pipeline handling, including functions for setting properties on GstElements, handling app sink samples, bus messages, and callbacks, specifically for video frame processing and signal management.

methods.name: c_glib_iteration
methods.description: Performs a specified number of iterations on the GLib main context.

methods.name: g_object_set_void
methods.description: Sets a property with a void pointer value on a GstElement.

methods.name: g_object_set_double
methods.description: Sets a double property on a GstElement.

methods.name: g_object_set_caps
methods.description: Sets the 'caps' property on a GstElement from a string.

methods.name: g_object_set_int
methods.description: Sets an integer property on a GstElement.

methods.name: c_appsink_set_sample_callback
methods.description: Sets a callback for new samples on an appsink element.

methods.name: c_appsink_pull_preroll
methods.description: Triggers a preroll callback on an appsink element.

methods.name: c_signal_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects a signal handler from a GstElement.

methods.name: c_on_bus_message
methods.description: Handles bus messages and invokes a callback.

methods.name: c_bus_connect_message
methods.description: Connects a callback to bus messages.
